messages.subject: Binding errors with nested output
parts:
An example app that demonstrates the problem:

#server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  output$interface <- renderUI({
    input$button
    div(
      uiOutput("out")
    )
  })
 
  output$out <- renderUI({
    div(
      textOutput("curr")
    )
  })
 
  output$curr <- renderText("test")
})

#ui.R
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  actionButton("button", "Button"),
  uiOutput("interface")
))

This results in Shiny complaining in the browser console about duplication of the "curr" ID. The problem is that there are never actually two elements with the ID "curr" in the HTML at the same time (as one of them is overwritten by the other). This seems to me to be caused by the nesting of the UI outputs.

Is there any way to work around this issue? Thanks!.

Thanks for the bug report! I've filed issue 749 and submitted PR 750.

In the meantime you can install this version using:
devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny@bugfix/nested-uioutput-duplicate-id")
